description: Found while building tab-agent-signals (PR #463): a stand-in claude binary at a long path (/private/tmp/claude-501/.../claude) was classified as 'unknown', while the same binary at /tmp/fb/claude classified as claude-code. Likely cause: ps comm truncation with a long argv0 defeats AgentDetector's argv0 rule. Real-world impact: agents launched via long absolute paths (worktree-local binaries, nix/homebrew cellar paths, version-manager shims) may lose harness detection, and with it the agent tag and model detection. Fix: resolve the executable from the full argv[0] or proc_pidpath rather than the truncated comm, then add a test with a >16-char basename and a long directory path.
title: AgentDetector misses agents launched through a long argv0 path
